board.name: Waveshare ESP32-S3-CAN-2CH
board.notes: ESP32-S3R8 module, 16 MB flash. Its octal PSRAM sits inside the chip on GPIO33-37, so those pins are not available even though this firmware does not use the PSRAM.

ports.name: Status LED
ports.notes: The board has no user LED, and GPIO2 is not connected to anything. Move the pin to a free header pin and enable this port to wire an external one.

ports.name: CAN_2
ports.notes: XL2515QF20 onboard CAN, 16 MHz crystal, no reset line.

ports.name: RS485
ports.notes: The board has no RS485 transceiver. Enable this port only with an external transceiver module wired to header P1: TX GPIO10 (P1-18), RX GPIO11 (P1-16), DE/RE GPIO12 (P1-14).

ports.name: Current sensor input
ports.notes: On header P1-20 (GPIO9, ADC1 channel 8). Shares GPIO9 with the SMA enable input and battery wake-up wup2, so only one of the three can be enabled.

ports.name: HIA4V1 precharge control
ports.notes: Reuses the primary contactor pins, so it replaces contactor_control rather than running alongside it.

ports.name: SMA inverter contactor enable
ports.notes: Shares GPIO9 with battery_wakeup wup2 and the current sensor input; only one of the three can be enabled.

ports.name: Battery wake-up
ports.notes: wup1 collides with the second battery contactor output and wup2 with the SMA enable input and the current sensor input. Enable only for a battery that needs wake-up, and disable the ports it displaces.
